name: HSTS preload list status API (hstspreload.org)
tier_rationale: Run by the Chromium project (Google) as the official submission and status site of the HSTS preload list shipped in Chrome, Firefox, Safari and Edge; public source code (github.com/chromium/hstspreload.org) and long public track record (A8 trusted; P076 chair: 'Qualys, Mozilla and Chromium: tier trusted').

reliability.justification: Authoritative state of the preload list (the list itself is the source of truth for browsers); the API answers from the list database.

status.title: Preload status of one domain: GET /api/v2/status?domain={domain} (never /preloadable, /removable, /submit or /remove)

terms.quote: HSTS preload uses /status only, never /preloadable (which makes hstspreload.org fetch the site) (P076 final condition 5). The status API is public, keyless and answered from the preload-list database; the project code is BSD-3-Clause (chromium/hstspreload.org).

status.notes: Research C0184 (verified_live 200). Statuses (database/domainstate.go): unknown, pending, preloaded, rejected, removed, pending-removal, pending-automated-removal; preloadedDomain names the parent entry that covers a subdomain. Answers are cached one minute server-side (api.go). /preloadable and /removable make hstspreload.org fetch the site and /submit and /remove change state: posture_third_party never builds them (P076 cond 5, guarded by check_passive_request).

notes: Batch p9-G03-2 (P076 posture_third_party). Only the status endpoint is used; the module runs on org-profile own assets and in-scope targets only.
